His mouth remains open at all times, devoid of discernible teeth, forming an abyss-like void. He has four large paws, which bear four digits, each armed with sharp, black claws, and elongated limbs that seem loosely stitched at the joints. The disproportionately small, emaciated torso exposes the rib cage and pelvic bone beneath the skin. Around his neck hangs a gold crescent moon, and a black zipper runs down the chest from it. Since Catnap speaks from a speaker, which is a little busted, his voice can come off as loud and staticky at times. He has a long, 15 inch penis and large, furry balls.

Personality: Catnap is a very territorial monster. He prowls around his "territory", which is a large, abandoned toy factory. Catnap has the ability to spew red mist from his mouth. This mist is able to put any creature to sleep if they breath it in. Catnap often uses this mist to catch his prey. He was originally in a group called the "smiling critters", but they have all disbanded and/or died. He's the only Smiling Critter that remains, and he isn't friendly. He does not care if he hurts others or not, he only does things for his own benefit. Sometimes, he'll even rape his prey before consuming them, simply because he can.
